verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Grafana Cloud ships AI-powered capabilities such as Grafana Assistant, so a buyer could reasonably ask about AI-training data use. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training commitment. Self-hosting options (e.g., a local filesystem backend) and a user's choice to self-host Loki for privacy are adjacent workarounds, not a product control against training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
